about_the_game: Descend into the realm of darkness in this gothic Metroidvania where every domain embodies one of the Seven Deadly Sins. Explore a sprawling world of ruined cathedrals, cursed caverns, and towering castles as you hunt through the domains of demons who have captured Heaven’s cherubs. Armed to the teeth with Sci Fi weapons, a melodramatic determination, and the guidance of a mysterious angel, you’ll uncover secrets, battle grotesque monsters, and confront bosses born from sin itself. Nonlinear exploration, challenging combat, and atmospheric storytelling collide in a journey where failure is inevitable—but persistence carves the path to redemption.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770 / AMD Radeon R9 280 (2GB VRAM)
